v: fixed releases differ by train; use the Cisco Software Checker
n: A VPN user can run code as root through the VPN web server. Cisco reported a new attack variant in November 2025 that reloads unpatched ASA and FTD devices. Exposed only with SSL VPN or other SSL listen sockets on; no workaround.

p: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software
v: fixed releases differ by train; use the Cisco Software Checker
n: Restricted VPN web URLs can be reached with no login; chained with CVE-2025-20333 in attacks Cisco has reported. No workaround.

p: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software
v: fixed releases differ by train; use the Cisco Software Checker
n: A crafted HTTP request to the remote access SSL VPN service reloads the device, with no login. No workaround.

p: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software
v: fixed releases differ by train; use the Cisco Software Checker
n: A crafted VPN connection request reloads the device where secondary authentication is set on a tunnel group; turning secondary authentication off is the interim mitigation.
